# system issuer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/systemIssuer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent or standpoint that issues a normative system as a whole. ⊑ [`normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md): issuing the system is issuing its stance. Member norms may still carry their own issuers (an annex contributed by another party).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NormativeSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NormativeSystem.md) -> `?`
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md) from [`gmeow:NormativeSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NormativeSystem.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md), [`gmeow:NormativeSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NormativeSystem.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent or standpoint that issues a whole normative system.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it on a single norm (use the general [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md)) and avoid assuming member norms inherit the system's issuer — an annex may carry its own.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md) from the [`gmeow:NormativeSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NormativeSystem.md) to its issuer; it specializes [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md), so the system's issuance surfaces in generic issuer queries.

### Examples

- ex:gdpr [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md) ex:euParliament.
